title: Knowledge Integration Decay in Search-Augmented Reasoning of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper identifies a technical bottleneck in LLM reasoning called Knowledge Integration Decay (KID) and proposes a method to mitigate it. While one of the case study examples (Figure 20) involves a query about a Catholic Cardinal and Martin Luther, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as a primary component; these are simply used as instances of complex multi-hop QA data.
